en: Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a rural village landscape with fields in the foreground and a cluster of buildings in the distance. On a small hill stands a church-like building with a tall tower and dome, surrounded by other village houses and farm structures. The lower right has a large blank area for writing, with red printed script text. A small red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner, and vertical printer information is along the left margin.
